title: Hanford begins offsite grouting of secondary EMF concentrate
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports the first transfer of Effluent Management Facility concentrate to a local offsite grouting facility after a regulatory permit was obtained. EMF concentrate is a secondary liquid byproduct of vitrification, and the grouted material is then to be shipped out of Washington for commercial disposal. Denominator: First reported EMF-concentrate transfer in July 2026; DOE states that one to three gallons of secondary material can be created per gallon vitrified but does not publish the transfer volume.
